concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal-web-component]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured PayPal Web Component guide for versioned Sessions/Payments setup, conditional Fraudnet/risk fields, webhook-final outcomes, recurring token gates and capture-sensitive refunds; table/example callback and field-placement conflicts remain in the source.
warnings: The /payments configuration table and example differ on callback name and merchantId/intent placement; avoid treating either snippet as a complete safe implementation.
The partial-refund lineItems prose uses conflicting item descriptions; preserve the raw and do not infer a new accounting rule.
This guide's modified metadata predates many later SDK/API versions and examples in the captured body; retain snapshot/version distinctions.
